agents.name: Foundation & Generics Module Agent
rules: 100.0% statement coverage across all foundation packages
Zero heavy transitive imports (gin, pgx, otel) in leaf foundation packages
Type-safe Go 1.26 generics without reflection in sliceutil and maputil
Allocation-conscious error wrapping, PII masking, and UUIDv7 monotonic ordering

agents.name: Resilience & Concurrency Module Agent
rules: 100.0% statement coverage across all resilience and concurrency packages
Zero data races under go test -race across concurrent goroutines, worker pools, and shards
Strict leaf import isolation (no gin, pgx, or otel in resilience leaf packages)
Context cancellation propagation and panic recovery in async and workerpool

agents.name: HTTP Transport & Gin Middleware Module Agent
rules: 100.0% statement coverage across all HTTP and Gin middleware packages
Zero heavy Gin imports inside pure net/http leaf packages (compress, bodylimit, securityheaders)
Pooled compression writers/readers and zero-leak response body handling
RFC 7807 / RFC 9457 Problem Details parity between net/http and Gin middlewares

agents.name: Data, Security & Observability Module Agent
rules: 100.0% statement coverage across data, security, and observability packages
Constant-time cryptographic comparisons and authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption
Context-propagated pgx transaction nesting (WithTx / savepoints) with rollback safety
Zero heavy dependencies in leaf security packages (cryptoutil, rbaccontext)

agents.name: Platform Governance, CI & Documentation Agent
rules: Bash 3.2 compatibility across all scripts/*.sh (scripts/test_shell_compatibility.sh)
36-package inventory and version parity across README.md, CHANGELOG.md, and docs/ (scripts/check_version.sh)
SHA-pinned GitHub Actions with explicit least-privilege permissions and Node 24 opt-in
Companion agent skills synchronized with repository APIs and verification gates
